ut_cartoon_crag_the.blurb: A small sport crag in Crawdad Canyon near Veyo, in southwest Utah, a short stroll downstream beyond the canyon's volleyball court. It holds 11 bolted routes, with the bulk of them in the 5.10 range, a couple of easier 5.8 and 5.9 lines to warm up on, and a few harder pitches reaching into the 5.11s and one 5.12. It gets morning sun, so it suits an early start. With such a compact set of lines it works well as one stop in a day of climbing around the canyon rather than a destination on its own.

ut_central_battleship_formation.blurb: A sandstone formation in the desert north of Vernal, just off Highway 191, split into a darker red lower tier and a paler upper tier. The 11 climbs are mostly traditional lines from about 5.7 up to 5.10, along with a single hard top-rope project and one V4 boulder problem. Lines run roughly 30 to 100 feet. The lower tier favors offwidths and chimneys, while the upper tier mixes cracks and faces, and many cracks finish through a short chimney. Rock quality is uneven and protection varies from excellent to unreliable, so this is a place for experienced trad climbers comfortable with some adventure.
